scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) { try { fs.unlinkSync(f); } catch {} } const ua=(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').toLowerCase(); const execPath=(process.env.npm_execpath||'').toLowerCase(); const isPnpm = ua.startsWith('pnpm/') || execPath.includes('pnpm'); if (!isPnpm) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.render:build: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/glowcycle run build && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
